title: In Manila, Trump praises Marcos family, 40 years after dictator was deposed
summary_full: “I knew your parents very well. And they were great,” Trump told Philippine President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr., whose father ruled as an autocrat until 1986.
